_comment: FROST Server (OGC SensorThings API) via APISIX Gateway proxy on the public API host. Owner: Team 2
_api_host_comment: No api_host default here. The host guard is configured at runtime via the platform-wide API_HOST env var (see providers/frost_server.rego, policy/env_contract.rego).
_permission_comment: Reading SensorThings content through this protected data-plane route requires DATASET_PAYLOAD_READ (payload access), NOT the broader metadata-level DATASET_READ. A user with only DATASET_READ (e.g. DATASET_ARCHITECT) must NOT be able to read FROST content. The /apis discovery endpoint is portal_backend, not this backend.
_open_data_comment: `_open_data: true` marks an endpoint as anonymously readable when the dataset is flagged openDataAccess=true (see policy/open_data.rego). It covers ALL FROST sub-resources because they all map to this single /v1/datasets/{id} pattern. Reads only; writes are never open.
